note: A capability is what a user wants, not how a provider ships it. Provider selection rules live here in registry policy, never in GUI code. Only DEM is seeded; the rest are declared so later waves extend this file rather than inventing a parallel taxonomy.

DEM.label: Bare-earth elevation

Canonicality_Rules.rule: MULTIPLE_CURRENT_MANIFESTATIONS + COMPLETE_EQUIVALENT_AOI_COVERAGE -> one deterministic canonical, others preserved as ALTERNATE_COMPLETE
Canonicality_Rules.deterministic_tiebreak: UTM zone 19N over 20N for the PR_PuertoRicoUSVI collection
Canonicality_Rules.never: Do not merge overlapping manifestations in different CRSs except inside an explicit comparison.

DEM.Refresh_Policy: Discover new collections; never mutate a frozen binding. A newer collection is adjudicated, not auto-promoted.

declared_for_later_waves.note: Spans the archipelago from summit to seafloor, plus the karst/void and contractor-facing layers the domain repos bind in Wave 4.
